\section[(dialogue)]{Places and describing words — a first pass}

\label{lesson:HI-R165-first-pass-places-and-describing-words}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for to play and to count.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item fresh, rich, poor, young, old
  \item wide, deep, high, low, empty
  \item full, to sleep, to wake up, to run, to put
  \item to send, to bring, to open, to wash, to bathe
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Fresh? (\textbf{\hi{ताज़ा}}, \emph{tāzā}.) Rich? (\textbf{\hi{अमीर}}, \emph{amīr}.) Poor? (\textbf{\hi{ग़रीब}}, \emph{ġarīb}.) Young? (\textbf{\hi{जवान}}, \emph{javān}.) Old? (\textbf{\hi{बूढ़ा}}, \emph{būṛhā}.) Wide? (\textbf{\hi{चौड़ा}}, \emph{cauṛā}.) Deep? (\textbf{\hi{गहरा}}, \emph{gahrā}.) High? (\textbf{\hi{ऊँचा}}, \emph{ū̃cā}.) Low? (\textbf{\hi{नीचा}}, \emph{nīcā}.) Empty? (\textbf{\hi{ख़ाली}}, \emph{khālī}.) Full? (\textbf{\hi{भरा}}, \emph{bharā}.) To sleep? (\textbf{\hi{सोना}}, \emph{sonā}.) To wake up? (\textbf{\hi{जागना}}, \emph{jāgnā}.) To run? (\textbf{\hi{दौड़ना}}, \emph{dauṛnā}.) To put? (\textbf{\hi{रखना}}, \emph{rakhnā}.) To send? (\textbf{\hi{भेजना}}, \emph{bhejnā}.) To bring? (\textbf{\hi{लाना}}, \emph{lānā}.) To open? (\textbf{\hi{खोलना}}, \emph{kholnā}.) To wash? (\textbf{\hi{धोना}}, \emph{dhonā}.) To bathe? (\textbf{\hi{नहाना}}, \emph{nahānā}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Verbs — a second pass}

\label{lesson:HI-R165-second-pass-verbs}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for to cook and to cut.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item to cook, to cut, to break, to fall, to fly
  \item to swim, to dance, to laugh, to cry, to forget
  \item to win, to lose, to sell, to look for, to wear
  \item to call, to teach, to learn, to arrive, to come back
  \item to catch, to touch, to explain, to play, to count
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
To cook? (\textbf{\hi{पकाना}}, \emph{pakānā}.) To cut? (\textbf{\hi{काटना}}, \emph{kāṭnā}.) To break? (\textbf{\hi{तोड़ना}}, \emph{toṛnā}.) To fall? (\textbf{\hi{गिरना}}, \emph{girnā}.) To fly? (\textbf{\hi{उड़ना}}, \emph{uṛnā}.) To swim? (\textbf{\hi{तैरना}}, \emph{tairnā}.) To dance? (\textbf{\hi{नाचना}}, \emph{nācnā}.) To laugh? (\textbf{\hi{हँसना}}, \emph{hãsnā}.) To cry? (\textbf{\hi{रोना}}, \emph{ronā}.) To forget? (\textbf{\hi{भूलना}}, \emph{bhūlnā}.) To win? (\textbf{\hi{जीतना}}, \emph{jītnā}.) To lose? (\textbf{\hi{हारना}}, \emph{hārnā}.) To sell? (\textbf{\hi{बेचना}}, \emph{becnā}.) To look for? (\textbf{\hi{ढूँढना}}, \emph{ḍhū̃ḍhnā}.) To wear? (\textbf{\hi{पहनना}}, \emph{pahannā}.) To call? (\textbf{\hi{बुलाना}}, \emph{bulānā}.) To teach? (\textbf{\hi{सिखाना}}, \emph{sikhānā}.) To learn? (\textbf{\hi{सीखना}}, \emph{sīkhnā}.) To arrive? (\textbf{\hi{पहुँचना}}, \emph{pahũcnā}.) To come back? (\textbf{\hi{लौटना}}, \emph{lauṭnā}.) To catch? (\textbf{\hi{पकड़ना}}, \emph{pakaṛnā}.) To touch? (\textbf{\hi{छूना}}, \emph{chūnā}.) To explain? (\textbf{\hi{समझाना}}, \emph{samjhānā}.) To play? (\textbf{\hi{बजाना}}, \emph{bajānā}.) To count? (\textbf{\hi{गिनना}}, \emph{ginnā}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
